name: 1960 Valdivia, Chile
outcome: Largest recorded earthquake. Generated a trans-Pacific tsunami with run-up exceeding 10 m locally and significant impacts across the Pacific basin.

name: 2004 Sumatra-Andaman
outcome: Generated a devastating Indian Ocean tsunami. No DART coverage existed in the Indian Ocean at the time; event catalysed global buoy expansion.

name: 2011 Tohoku, Japan
outcome: Near-field tsunami with run-up exceeding 30 m locally. DART buoys in the Pacific confirmed trans-oceanic propagation within 30 minutes.

name: 2010 Maule, Chile
outcome: Generated a significant Pacific-wide tsunami. SIFT inversion constrained the source within 45 minutes of the first DART detection.

name: 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption
magnitude_note: Ms 5.8 (USGS NEIC); volcanic source, no conventional Mw. VEI-5+ eruption generated tsunami via atmospheric coupling, not seafloor displacement.
outcome: Volcanic rather than seismic source. Generated atmospheric-coupled tsunami waves detectable globally. Challenged conventional seismic-first detection workflows.

name: 2010 Haiti
outcome: Devastating on land. Generated localised tsunami (up to 3 m run-up) along the southern coast, likely triggered by submarine landslides and aftershocks rather than primary fault rupture.

name: 2015 Gorkha, Nepal
outcome: Continental interior earthquake. No tsunami risk. Demonstrates that magnitude alone does not predict tsunami generation.

name: 2018 Lombok, Indonesia
outcome: Shallow thrust event generating localised tsunami. Minor waves at most locations but up to 2 m at Kayangan (North Lombok). Demonstrates threshold where moderate earthquakes can produce small but measurable tsunamis.

name: 2023 Kahramanmaras, Turkey
outcome: Continental strike-slip earthquake doublet. No tsunami generated despite high magnitude. Focal mechanism incompatible with tsunami generation.

name: 2024 Noto Peninsula, Japan
outcome: Near-field thrust event generating localised tsunami with run-up exceeding 6 m. DART buoys confirmed signal within 15 minutes; short warning window for coastal communities.
